text:
rachel: quick note - rolling runtime v4.0 to canary triggered an unexpected model binding error for models with KV quantization. Putting a temporary pin on v4.0 for modelGroup:quantized to prevent canary expansion.

deploy-bot: pin created 'pin-283001' (scope=runtime:v4.0, modelGroup:quantized, region:global-canary). Reason: model-bind-failure on kv-quantized models.

ben: can we route quantized models to v3.9 until we sort? deploy-bot can do route rewriting by modelGroup yes?

deploy-bot: yes. Suggested: `/deploy route-update --match "model.group=quantized" --fallback runtime:v3.9 --scope canary` (dry-run available).

maya: repro looks like a kernel ABI mismatch in the new allocator path, small off-by-eight in offsets. I'm working on a micro-patch to the runtime allocator.

rachel: thanks. Action items: 1) maya will push micro-patch + canary build, 2) ben will run routing dry-run and coordinate small traffic shift if green, 3) ops will monitor.

ops-bot: scheduled monitor job: watch group=quantized canary error-rate for 60m, alert if >0.1%.

ben: dry-run OK, estimated impact <2% traffic. Recommend promote routing fallback to v3.9 for quantized model traffic in canary.

maya: pushed runtime patch and built v4.0.1-canary. Running the repro against that build now.

rachel: do not remove pin until we see 2h stable metrics and repro green. Also add a release-note entry about temporary routing fallback.

deploy-bot: routing promoted at 2830012380 per owner approval. Pin 'pin-283001' remains active and requires manual release.

ben: will draft the release blurb and update the release tracker.

maya: repro passed on v4.0.1-canary; scheduling 2h soak.

rachel: thanks all. post-unpin checklist: 1) soak OK, 2) canary metrics within thresholds, 3) release notes updated, 4) owners approve `release-pin`.
